review_policy: Figures change. These records point at live sources and state what applies to whom. Verify amounts at the source before quoting.

rules.detail: Contractors must verify subcontractors with HMRC and deduct tax from payments unless gross-payment status holds. Applies to construction work including electrical, plumbing, and related trades.
rules.citation: HMRC CIS guidance; Finance Act 2004 Part 3
rules.owner_action: Register as contractor if applicable; verify each subcontractor before first payment; file monthly CIS returns.
rules.escalation: Ask an accountant before first subcontractor payment.
rules.failure_mode: Penalties for unverified payments and late returns.

rules.detail: Keep business records (income, expenses, VAT, payroll) for at least 6 years from the end of the accounting period. Applies to sole traders, partnerships, and limited companies.
rules.applies_when: Running any business in the UK.
rules.owner_action: Store invoices, receipts, and bank records durably; back up digital records.
rules.escalation: Ask an accountant what counts for your structure.

rules.detail: Businesses must register for VAT when taxable turnover exceeds the threshold in a rolling 12-month period. DO NOT quote the amount from memory — check the live threshold at the source below, as it changes.
rules.citation: VATA 1994 Sch 1; HMRC VAT registration guidance
rules.owner_action: Monitor rolling 12-month turnover monthly; check the live threshold; register within 30 days of exceeding.
rules.escalation: Ask an accountant before registering or deregistering.
rules.failure_mode: Late registration penalties and backdated VAT bills.

rules.law: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
rules.detail: Self-employed businesses and landlords above the qualifying income threshold must keep digital records and file quarterly updates via compatible software. Thresholds and start dates phase in — check the live source.
rules.applies_when: Self-employed or landlord income near the qualifying threshold.
rules.owner_action: Confirm whether the current phase covers your income level; adopt compatible software before the deadline.
rules.escalation: Ask an accountant about phase timing for your situation.

rules.detail: Businesses can claim interest (Bank of England base rate + 8%) plus fixed compensation on qualifying overdue commercial debts, and Implied payment terms of 30 days apply unless agreed otherwise.
rules.citation: Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998
rules.owner_action: State payment terms on every quote/invoice; claim interest where appropriate.
rules.escalation: Debt recovery advice for large overdue sums.
